architecture.core: unaltered reference HybridPilot: selective diagonal SSM -> causal attention -> read-before-write TTTLinearMemory -> threshold conditional depth
architecture.hypothesis: same factual history independently read for each candidate, tagged no-outcome probe, model weights/state unchanged by preview
architecture.input: continuous sensor, completed executed scalar action, factual next sensor, physical delta-time; no tokenizer
architecture.persistent_memory: bounded tensor-only ring of actual observed transitions, cold-restorable
architecture.rank_gate: minimum three facts; rank [1,cumulative elapsed,executed action] necessary but not sufficient for causal inference

limitations: This is the compact CPU reference architecture, not official Mamba2, TTT-E2E or paper-exact MoD.
This is a composability and information-isolation candidate, not trained intelligence.
The TTT fast matrix is recomputed from retained facts on every candidate branch rather than persisted as optimized weights.
Rank cannot prove causality in endogenous/convolved or nonlinear nuisance settings.
Synthetic engineering outcomes do not justify model scientific promotion.
The original depth router writes utilization telemetry during forward, but no weights or factual tensor memory.
negative_and_controls: actions perfectly collinear with elapsed time -> abstain
rank adequate alternating actual actions -> preview and caller supplied goal selection
hypothetical actions never append durable observed outcomes or change weights
cold tensor plus weight restore bit exact
gradients reach all four original components
no tokenizer or lexical objective in imported path
